parse.title: Bow of the Quiddity
parse.text:
Introduced:  Lost in the New Horizon Related Quests:  Quiddity Weapons Quest, Weapon Upgrade Kit Updated:  Master of Arms
Bow of the Quiddity
Value: 2,000
550 Burden Units

A weapon made of a strange pulsating energy.

Skill: Missile Weapons (Bow)
Damage Bonus: 0 (16)
Damage Modifier: +113%
Speed: Slow (50) (10)
Range: 75 yds
Uses arrows as ammunition.
Bonus to Melee Defense: +0% (+10.0%)

Casts the following spells: Aura of Defender IV, Aura of Blood Drinker V, Aura of Swift Killer IV

Activation Requirements: Arcane Lore: 50

Spellcraft: 400
Mana: 1000
Mana Cost: 1 point per 40 seconds.

Notes

  • Obtained by handing a Quiddity Ingot to the Crafter of Bows.
  • Can be upgraded to an Enhanced Bow of the Quiddity by using a Weapon Upgrade Kit on it.
  • During the Master of Arms event, the skill was changed from Bow to Missile Weapons, the requirement of Arcane Lore:1 & Bow:200 was changed to Arcane Lore:50

* Obtained by handing a [[Quiddity Ingot]] to the [[Crafter of Bows]].
